title: Pro Shop Store Credit: redemption amount under the rolling monthly ceiling
content:
## Applies to
Pro Shop Store Credit: this document covers how much of a member's account may be redeemed toward a single purchase, measured against the tier's own redemption ceiling over a rolling window, for every tier of this product.

## Basis
The amount that may be redeemed toward a purchase is the lesser of two figures: the account's current spendable balance, and the space still available under the tier's own daily redemption ceiling once redemptions already recorded within the calendar month immediately preceding this request are subtracted from that ceiling. This measurement runs over the calendar month immediately preceding the request, rather than the single calendar day the ceiling's own name might suggest -- every redemption recorded within that trailing month counts against the ceiling for this request, not only redemptions recorded earlier the same day.

## Points of judgement (hypothetical)
Suppose a tier's own daily redemption ceiling is 150.00 USD, the account already shows 130.00 USD in redemptions recorded within the calendar month immediately preceding this request, and the account's current balance is 200.00 USD. The space still available under the ceiling is 20.00 USD (150.00 USD less the 130.00 USD already recorded this trailing month) -- not the full 150.00 USD, which would be the figure if the ceiling reset every single day rather than measuring the trailing month as a whole. Because the account's current balance of 200.00 USD exceeds that 20.00 USD of remaining space, the amount available to redeem toward this purchase is the smaller figure: 20.00 USD.
